scope: sole-comb HOST source only: the Bend 2 files under bin/, lib/, surface/, wasm/ and dev/. The sole-comb object language has no @unsafe (Q2+Q3). Test-only test/pinfront/ files use the same purity and site checks, and are excluded from the production import closure.
unsafe_meaning: These scoped host functions bypass Bend termination checking. Type, affine-use and exhaustiveness checks remain required. A new entry needs a reviewed registry change.
catchall_meaning: These named host functions use catch-all match rows for scalar dispatch, parser fallback or explicit refusal. The sites field is the exact number of catch-all rows in the function. A new row or function needs a reviewed registry change.

catchalls.reason: Scalar byte dispatch refuses every unlisted escape.
The remaining scalar bytes use the pinned printable or three-digit decimal escape rule.
Only numeric zero and one consume a quantity mark; every other prefix is retained.
Pinned recursive-descent lookahead uses explicit refusal or returns the untouched suffix at named grammar boundaries. Result and task variants remain exhaustive.
Byte tokens include their full contents; every other token delegates to the exhaustive pinned token description.
Recognizes named family or constructor application heads; other syntax has no named mutual-family reference.
Recognizes collection and mutual-family eliminations; other formers receive the pinned explicit refusal.
Collects successive arrow binders and returns the first non-arrow syntax as the result type.
Accepts the declared family as a constructor result and explicitly refuses other result types.
Recognizes applications while collecting a family result spine; other terms end the spine.
Extracts a universe level and explicitly refuses other checked family result types.

unsafe.reason: The positive Nat argument is divided by the literal 32768 on each recursion, strictly decreasing to zero. Type, affine-use and exhaustive checks remain enabled.
Normalized nonnegative radix-32768 magnitude is divided by the literal 10 on each recursion. Trimming quotient limbs makes the magnitude strictly decrease to the empty zero representation.

Each worklist step removes one term node and prepends only its strict subterms. The total syntax-node count of the pending finite forest decreases by one. The stack preserves the pinned shape, address, scrutinee, motive and branch order. Bend cannot infer this measure through scan_term; type, affine-use and exhaustive checks remain enabled.

Linear suspended programs compose result continuations without mutually recursive Bend declarations. Recursive composition occurs only when a request resumes. Bend cannot establish the semantic decrease through the continuation. Type, affine-use and exhaustive checks remain enabled.

The error handler is threaded through a linear suspended program so failed annotation probes are caught after nested requests finish. Recursive traversal is delayed in the continuation; Bend cannot prove its decrease. Type, affine-use and exhaustive checks remain enabled.

The evaluator/converter executes typed requests and resumes their linear continuations. Semantic evaluation and readback decrease on the checked strongly normalizing fragment, a measure Bend cannot infer through closures. Unchecked raw terms may diverge as in the pinned OCaml evaluator; this declaration does not claim totality for arbitrary syntax. Type, affine-use and exhaustive checks remain enabled.

The signed collection width is checked nonnegative before this loop. Each step decrements its positive remaining count without wraparound. Bend cannot infer this numeric measure through Int63.pred; type, affine-use and exhaustive checks remain enabled.

Each worklist expansion replaces one syntax node by its strict subterms and literal text. Text is consumed on the next step, so the finite pending syntax measure decreases. Bend cannot infer this measure through the expansion type; type, affine-use and exhaustive checks remain enabled.

The checker executes typed requests and resumes linear continuations. Every inference request consumes the shared remaining budget, including nested requests. Evaluation and conversion retain the pinned strongly normalizing checked-fragment assumption; arbitrary unchecked semantic values may diverge as in the oracle. Type, affine-use and exhaustive checks remain enabled.
The byte list decreases on every selected recursive branch; the location accumulator increases.
Every recursive branch consumes source bytes before resuming the literal scan.
Each selected lexical branch consumes bytes. Span and literal helpers return only the unconsumed suffix.
Rendering tasks traverse strict syntax subterms or a shrinking list of pending rendering tasks.
The immutable token parser follows the pinned recursive-descent grammar. Successful loops consume tokens; one failed speculative binder probe falls back to the ordinary parser at the same position.
The test serializer traverses strict syntax subterms and shrinking lists. Node and sequence tasks add a finite rendering step per source node.
Builds finite field placeholders by decrementing a positive signed count to zero; nonpositive counts terminate immediately.
Interprets suspended recursive requests over pinned surface subterms and finite declaration telescopes. Kernel checking remains explicit and no recursive program admission is provided here.
Composes a suspended elaboration continuation whose next program becomes available only after the requested subterm returns.
The lambda view returns a strict body subterm of a section with one binder.
Each recursive step removes one point Out node from the application spine.
The work list visits strict subterms; a stopped non-point Out is expanded exactly once.
